selection_criterion: |target_celltype_mean - mean(other_celltype_means)|, top N by score, computed from IAMAtlas REBUILD per-celltype posterior means with skipna handling; stem_pluri uses its class-level column (only cell type in that class)
algorithm_provenance: one-vs-rest top-N marker selection algorithm, originally implemented as identify_marker_cpgs() in val_093.py; applied to IAMAtlas REBUILD per-celltype posterior means in this artifact.
build_session: iamatlas_celltype_markers_v0_2 — clarify algorithm provenance, drop external-atlas reference
supersession_reason: v0_1 contained a "selection_logic_source" field referencing Loyfer-tile usage in val_093.py, which was confusing because the data itself is fully IAMAtlas REBUILD. v0_2 renames the field to "algorithm_provenance" and clarifies the algorithm is borrowed but the data is IAM-only.

_sex_marker_removal.reason: derived sex-invariance: chrX markers dropped so sex cannot shift an A-score; replaces cohort-built sex foreground subtraction
